question: Show the citation chain from "DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models" up to depth 1
canonical_question: Show the citation chain from "DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models" up to depth 1
gold_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE root AS (SELECT paper_id FROM paper WHERE upper(title)=upper('DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models')),
                 hops(pid,n) AS (SELECT paper_id,0 FROM root UNION
                 SELECT c.cited_id,h.n+1 FROM hops h JOIN citation c ON h.pid=c.citing_id WHERE h.n < 1)
                 SELECT p.paper_id,p.title,min(h.n) AS depth FROM paper p JOIN hops h ON h.pid=p.paper_id
                 WHERE h.n>0 AND p.paper_id NOT IN (SELECT paper_id FROM root)
                 GROUP BY p.paper_id,p.title ORDER BY depth,p.paper_id
